Excellent crab hot pot!
Jan 2018 • Couples
We decided on the crab hot pot when we visited Cua Bien Quan mostly based on the trip advisor reviews. The staff were super helpful, they spoke enough English & the calculator never lies to help us through the menu. 
The hot pot was 390k Dong, this is served with rice noodles & a plate of greens with some chilli sauce. The great thing about ordering the hot pot is that the staff literally do everything for you except eat! 
They light the fire for you, monitor the hot pot, place the crab in the liquid once it’s ready & even crack the crab claws for you once done. As we were clearly rookies the waitress also showed us how to add the greens & the rice noodles to the broth for optimal enjoyment. 
For the hot pot & four beers we paid approx 450k Dong (about $25AUD). For the two of us there was more than enough.
We felt it was great value for money & thoroughly enjoyed our meal. If you’re looking for an excellent hot pot in Danang, definitely give this place a go. We didn’t try anything else on the menu so I can’t comment on that however the restaurant was pretty busy & the other dishes being brought out looked delicious & fresh.
